panels.description: Exact percentiles off Paper's raw per-tick array. A p50 far below the mean means an idle server with rare spikes -- chase the spike, not the average.
panels.title: Tick time percentiles

panels.description: Caps at 20, so it cannot show headroom. MSPT is the honest number.
panels.title: TPS

panels.description: histogram_quantile over the cumulative tick histogram. Unlike the exact percentiles above, these aggregate across any window and across servers, at the resolution of the histogram buckets.
panels.title: Tick time quantiles from the histogram

panels.description: Ticks completed per second from the histogram count. Unlike mc_tps it is not capped at 20 or smoothed, and it drops to zero while Paper pauses an empty server.
panels.title: Actual ticks per second

panels.description: Share of ticks per duration bucket over time. A band creeping upward is a server getting slower everywhere; a scattered top row is occasional stalls.
panels.title: Tick time distribution

panels.description: Folia and Canvas only. Folia has no single server tick, so the panels above stay empty there and these take their place; on Paper it is the other way round. Sampled at the locations of online players, so it is empty with nobody online.
panels.title: Regional TPS (Folia)

panels.description: Folia and Canvas only. Folia has no single server tick, so the panels above stay empty there and these take their place; on Paper it is the other way round. Regional MSPT needs a server that exposes per-region tick times, which today means Canvas; pure Folia reports regional TPS only.
panels.title: Regional tick time (Folia)

panels.description: Max is the 8G Xmx from compose.
panels.title: Heap

panels.description: System load is reported for the JVM's operating environment, so on a containerised server it reflects the container's cgroup rather than the machine.
panels.title: CPU load

panels.description: Occupancy right after each pool was last collected: the leak signal the live heap gauge cannot give, because the live figure oscillates with every allocation. Pool names depend on the collector in use.
panels.title: Memory pools after the last collection

panels.description: Direct and mapped buffers the JDK tracks. Netty's pooled network buffers are allocated outside this accounting on HotSpot, so this is a lower bound for direct memory.
panels.title: NIO buffer pools

panels.description: Seconds of GC per second. Sustained high values stall the tick loop.
panels.title: GC time rate by collector

panels.description: Thread budget matters more than count -- 12 threads on 8 cores once cost 1.3 TPS.
panels.title: Threads

panels.description: Per-world, from Paper's O(1) counters. A rising floor here lifts MSPT with it.
panels.title: Entities by world

panels.description: Hoppers and chests. Cheaper per unit than entities but they add up.
panels.title: Tile entities by world

panels.description: Sampled on a slower cadence -- the only reading that walks the entity list. Empty when no chunks are loaded.
panels.title: Top entity types

panels.description: Chunk churn per second. The loaded-chunk gauge hides it because loads and unloads cancel out; a high churn with a flat chunk count is players moving at the view-distance edge.
panels.title: Chunk loads and unloads by world

panels.description: Chunks created for the first time per second. Generation is the most expensive thing a tick does; sustained values point at exploration or a missing pregeneration.
panels.title: Chunks generated by world

panels.description: Empty when nobody is online: TickScope publishes ping only when at least one player was actually measured, so an idle server is not reported as 0 ms.
panels.title: Ping

panels.description: Counters, not samples -- a join between two scrapes is still counted.
panels.title: Event rate

panels.description: Time spent collecting TickScope snapshots. Main and entity scans run on separate cadences.
panels.title: Collection cost

panels.description: Time spent collecting TickScope snapshots. Main and entity scans run on separate cadences.
panels.title: Collection age

panels.description: Time spent collecting TickScope snapshots. Main and entity scans run on separate cadences.
panels.title: Collection failures

panels.description: Successful player pings / requested players in the last completed or expired batch. Zero requested players displays 0; regional API availability is reported separately by regional sample counts.
panels.title: Folia player sample coverage

panels.description: Open versus allowed file descriptors. Region files and sockets both count; running out stops the server from opening worlds and connections.
panels.title: File descriptors

panels.description: Connections closed before a request was read, by reason. per_address means one client address exceeded max-connections-per-address, typically several scrapers behind one proxy; saturated means every worker and queue slot was held by stalled clients.
panels.title: Connections the endpoint turned away

title: TickScope — Minecraft Server
description: TickScope metrics for Paper, Purpur, Folia and Canvas. Tick performance panels populate on Paper; the Folia regions row populates on Folia and Canvas.
